newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron sees 97 sales volume up over 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Petron sees 97 sales volume up over 6 pct.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp said on Monday it expects sales volume this year to increase by more than the industry average.
"We are targetting to outpace the industry's growth of over six percent annually," Petron president Ali Al-Ajmi told reporters after the stockholders' meeting.
Petron chairman Monico Jacob told the meeting that the company is changing its image to meet increasing competition after the recent deregulation of the oil industry.
Petron will set up 40 new service stations and upgrade another 40 at a cost of at least 200 million pesos, Al-Ajmi said.
He expected Petron will exceed the 41.4 percent market share it commanded in 1996.
Last year overall sales rose eight percent to a record high of 58.73 million barrels from 54.27 million the previous year.
Petron is the biggest of the three oil refiners in the Philippines.
